text: Python SDK covers conversion, pipelines, structured extraction, form filling, and file management

quote: Extract specific fields with citations back to source bounding boxes for auditability

text: Automatically generate candidate extraction schemas for a given file
quote: For a given file, generate potential extraction schemas.

quote: Pipelines chain processors (convert, extract, segment, custom) into reusable, versioned configurations.

quote: You can override the default webhook URL for specific API requests by including the webhook_url parameter

text: Use the page_range parameter to process documents that exceed limits in segments

quote: Review cost_breakdown in the completed response for the billed amount.

quote: Datalab bills for the processors and add-ons you run. Most have per-page rates; some also use measured compute costs.

text: Hosted file storage for documents reused across pipelines and multiple API calls
quote: Datalab provides file storage for documents you want to process with pipelines or reuse across multiple API calls.

quote: Run a published agent processor on a document. Address it with processor=<id>, optionally pinned to a version as <id>@<version>

quote: This endpoint is used to check the health of the API, given an API key.
